market.title: Grok Imagine's Odyssey Film
resolutionNote: Resolves Yes if a full-length film adaptation of The Odyssey, made using Grok Imagine and released by Grok or an official Musk-controlled account, is made publicly available through an official channel (theatrical release, streaming, physical media, or authorized digital purchase) before January 1, 2027.
Private screenings, festival showings, leaks, and torrent availability don't count, and a trailer or soundtrack alone doesn't satisfy the criterion -- the full film has to be released.
This is Kalshi's own stated resolution wording, not Musk's original pledge, which was vaguer (no defined release process).

marketBrief.text: xAI has real momentum in AI video: Grok Imagine went from zero video generation a year ago to over 1.2 billion clips generated in a single month by January 2026, with 720p footage, motion, and synced audio. But everything shown publicly still tops out around three minutes -- the demo that prompted Musk's pledge has been described as visually striking with 'wooden' dialogue. Musk's own roadmap calls for a 'watchable' full-length film by the end of 2026, a lower bar than a 'historically accurate' feature in five months. No director, cast, or release plan exists yet, and Kalshi prices this as a longshot in the 20s.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
